text:
Anya: ACME Finance asked for contract-scoped retention (7y), per-contract TTLs, SLA credits if we shorten retention. Also BYOK + rotation aligned to retention.
Sam: Do we support contract-level TTLs today?
Marta: No, only tenant-level. Per-contract is new surface.
Rohan: Ops: arbitrary TTLs => big index + search costs. We need guardrails.
Priya: Proposal: discrete retention tiers (1y, 3y, 7y) selectable at contract-sign. Pricing multiplier per tier.
Ben: BYOK risk: if customer rotates/revokes keys, can we produce evidence for the retention period?
legal-bot: Note: contractual retention means we must be able to produce evidence. If customer holds keys, require escrow or explicit export protocol.
Sam: Suggest two BYOK modes: BYOK_with_escrow (hosted escrow under constraints) and BYOK_no_escrow (no escrow, reduced export guarantees).
Anya: MVP split: (1) retention_tiers + billing/SLA formula; (2) KMS lifecycle + evidence export/escrow.
Priya: Billing formula draft: SLA_credits = base * ceil(ttl_days / 365). Example base=1 -> 7y => 7x. Simple and auditable.
Ben: Evidence export must be verifiable: signed bundle + manifest, merkle proofs. Define search/export SLA (24h for P1).
Marta: Acceptance criteria draft: tier selected at contract time; kms_mode set at onboarding; export job produces signed bundle within 24h for P1; documented key-rotation/revocation playbook.
Rohan: Ops asks for cold-archive index path to avoid hot-index costs and an export runner that stitches from archive.
Anya: MVP scope: implement tiers (1/3/7y) + billing hook; BYOK_with_escrow for hosted; BYOK_no_escrow with limited guarantees; export API w/24h P1 SLA; PB for Private deployments.
Marta: Rough sizing: spec + API (1), billing + enforcement (2), escrow + legal (2), export pipeline (3). Parallelize where possible.
Priya: I'll draft customer pricing blurb and legal escalation playbook.
Ben: I'll prototype signed manifest + merkle index.
Rohan: I'll draft ops runbook for export runner and storage lifecycle.
Anya: Drop a quick :white_check_mark: if you can own the action this sprint.
